proposal.summary: An insufficient session expiration vulnerability exists in the ArubaOS command line interface.

AV.quote: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to keep a session running on an affected device after the removal of the impacted account.

C.quote: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to keep a session running on an affected device after the removal of the impacted account.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate session management practices and implement proper session expiration mechanisms.
